title: REQ · Inline success feedback is shown after a successful send alongside the existing error feedback
summary: A role=status 'Suggestion sent' message appears on success and clears on new input or a new send; errors keep their role=alert message.
description: Context: success is only implied by the entry's 'Sent' label. Desired behavior: after submitContribution resolves, show 'Suggestion sent' in a role=status paragraph; clear it when the user types or starts another send; a failure clears it and shows the existing error. Why: explicit confirmation to the player.
acceptance_criteria: Given submitContribution resolves, when the request settles, then a role=status element with 'Suggestion sent' is visible and no error alert is shown.
Given submitContribution rejects with 429, when the request settles, then the 'Slow down, try again shortly' alert is shown and the success message is absent.
Given a visible success message, when the user types in the textarea, then the success message is removed.

preserve: errorMessage function and the role=alert error paragraph

technical_constraints: Success message is inside the sheet, not a global toast
definition_of_done: Success and error messages are mutually exclusive and clear correctly
non_functional: Success message uses role=status so it is announced politely
